premises.text: Apartment search UX is broken: thin listings, dead links, and Craigslist spam/reposts hide unique inventory
premises.evidence_span: It's a really poor user experience, and we all know that

premises.text: Zumper listings are curated directly from brokers, landlords, and property managers rather than scraped
premises.evidence_span: all the listings you see on the map, these are all curated. They're not scraped

premises.text: Neighborhood pages and follow/news-feed search help renters discover areas and tailored listings
In-product messaging lets qualified renters share credentials and lets brokers compare applicant profiles
premises.evidence_span: we created a messaging tool to help with that

premises.text: Expansion is bottom-up business development with leading landlords and brokers city by city
premises.evidence_span: We're doing a lot of business development with the leading landlords and brokers in the States to build this bottom up

value.text: Search and inquire for an apartment quickly and close without the open-house song and dance
value.evidence_span: search for and make an inquiry for an apartment in under three minutes

secondary_value.text: Brokers and landlords screen interested renters more efficiently
secondary_value.evidence_span: the advantage for the broker or landlord is that it's tremendously efficient for them

causal_links.evidence_span: inquiry for an apartment in under three minutes

notes: Neighborhood page, newsfeed, and messaging kept as one product-discovery module with messaging still inside D2 because speaker presents them as one recap of the product; messaging could have been a singleton but is tightly coupled to closing the listing. Traffic overnight excluded as traction. Zillow IPO mention excluded.
